description: This Java source file defines an Android instrumented test class 'InstrumentedTest' that interacts with UI elements and accessibility nodes on an Android device. It includes methods for parsing selectors, performing UI actions (click, drag, swipe, etc.), retrieving accessibility info, and running a socket-based command loop for testing automation.

classes.name: InstrumentedTest
classes.description: A test class executing UI automation on an Android device, including socket communication and accessibility node serialization.
